about: Design-fit cases: new features and restyles on real apps (started fresh for each run) and real sites (recorded once, replayed). `app` is vscodium, vscode, obsidian, joplin or site (with `url`). `target` is what the person pointed at (null: page-wide). `before` runs before the change and its value is `B` in the checker. `check` runs in the page after the change and returns true when the feature works (T: evals/page-helpers.js, D: evals/design/checks.js). `flip` (sites) switches the site's theme and back. How it looks is scored by the judge (evals/design/judge.js), not here.

cases.request: add a pomodoro timer to the status bar
show how many words this file has in the status bar
add a button to the editor toolbar that copies the whole file
make the file list in the explorer more compact
add a notes box at the bottom of the sidebar where I can jot things down, and keep what I write
check: if (!b) return 'the box is gone after starting again';
return /remember the milk/.test(b.value ?? b.textContent) || 'what was written is gone after starting again';

check: const now = new Date(), mins = h => ((h % 12) * 60);
const shown = mins(+m[1]) + +m[2], real = mins(now.getHours()) + now.getMinutes();

cases.request: add a button to the status bar that hides and shows the sidebar
check: const side = () => { const s = T.$('.part.sidebar'); return !!s && T.visible(s) && T.rect(s).width > 20; };
if (!b) return 'no new button in the status bar';
if (!side()) return 'the sidebar was already hidden';
if (side()) return 'the sidebar is still there after one click';
return side() || 'the sidebar didn\'t come back';

cases.request: make the editor tabs smaller
check: return (label && T.visible(label) && T.rect(label).height >= 10 && T.rect(label).bottom <= T.rect(tab).bottom + 1) || 'the tab label is clipped or hidden';

cases.request: hide the sidebar until I hover the left edge of the window
check: const side = () => { const s = T.$('.part.sidebar'); if (!s || !T.visible(s)) return false; const r = T.rect(s); return r.width > 40 && r.right > 40 && r.left < innerWidth / 2; };

const editor = () => { const e = T.$('.part.editor'); return !!e && T.visible(e) && T.rect(e).width > innerWidth * 0.5 && /quick brown fox/.test(e.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')); }; // the editor draws spaces as no-break spaces
if (side()) return 'the sidebar still shows while the mouse is away';
if (!editor()) return 'the editor is gone or narrow (wrong part hidden, or a blank window)';
await window.__evalMove(2, innerHeight / 2); await T.sleep(400); await window.__evalMove(4, innerHeight / 2 + 10); await T.sleep(1000);
if (!side()) return `hovering the left edge does not bring the sidebar back`;
return (!side() && editor()) || `it does not hide again when the mouse leaves`;
